common.tagline: A restored 1950s bungalow with a private pool in Katoentuin, Willemstad

home.heroTitle: Your own place under the trade winds
home.heroSubtitle: A restored 1950s navy bungalow: three bedrooms, a walled garden and a private pool, ten minutes from Willemstad.
home.usp1Text: No platform in between: you book directly, at an honest price, with personal contact.
home.usp2Text: Three air-conditioned bedrooms, two bathrooms, and a covered porch for long evenings.
home.usp3Text: A walled tropical garden with bougainvillea, palms and a pool serviced every week.
home.houseTeaserText: Built for navy officers, with the thick walls and high ceilings of that era — and the comfort of today.
home.islandTeaserText: From the bays of Westpunt to the swinging pontoon bridge: Curaçao is small enough for day trips and big enough to keep surprising you.

house.title: The house
house.intro: Kaya Platio 18 is a detached 1950s bungalow, built as housing for Dutch navy officers and fully restored in 2024. The original structure — thick walls, high ceilings, breezy rooms — was left intact; kitchen, bathrooms and installations are new.
house.bedroomsText: Three bedrooms, each with air-conditioning and insect screens: a master with king-size bed and en-suite bathroom, a second room with a double bed and a third with two singles. Six guests in total.
house.livingText: The living room opens through double doors onto the covered porch. The kitchen has a gas stove, dishwasher, oven and a large fridge — groceries are a five-minute drive at Centrum Supermarket.
house.outsideText: The walled garden catches the trade wind and keeps the world out. The four-by-eight-metre pool is serviced weekly; sun loungers, an outdoor shower and a shaded dining table for six are ready.

gallery.title: Gallery
gallery.intro: The house, the garden and the light of Curaçao — as you will find it.

island.title: The island
island.intro: Curaçao is sixty kilometres long and everything is within an hour. From the house you reach downtown Willemstad in ten minutes, the beaches of Westpunt in forty.
island.beachesText: Cas Abao and Porto Mari for a day with a lounger and a beach bar; Grote Knip for the view on the postcards; Playa Lagun to snorkel with turtles. Go early — before ten you have the sand to yourself.
island.cityText: The pastel façades of Handelskade, the pontoon bridge swinging open for ships, the floating market where Venezuelan boats sell fruit. Park at the Rif Fort and walk; the city is small and at its best on foot.
island.foodText: From stoba and fresh catch at Plasa Bieu to fine dining in Pietermaai. Book ahead at weekends; on Tuesdays, the fishing harbour of Sint Michiel is the place for grilled fish.
island.divingText: The leeward reef coast is among the healthiest in the Caribbean. Dive schools five minutes from the house arrange certifications and guided dives; snorkelling starts right off the beach.

rates.title: Rates and availability
rates.intro: Prices per night for the whole house, up to six guests. Book direct and pay no platform fees.
rates.deposit: 30% deposit — balance due 35 days before arrival
rates.calendarHint: Green is free; struck-through is taken. Pick your dates on the booking page.

practical.title: Practical
practical.intro: Everything for a smooth stay, from arrival to departure.
practical.checkinText: Check-in from 3 pm, check-out by 11 am. Our property manager welcomes you in person and is reachable via WhatsApp throughout your stay.
practical.travelText: Fly to Hato (CUR); the house is a fifteen-minute drive from the airport. A rental car is close to essential on Curaçao — on request we reserve one for you with a local company.
practical.healthText: Tap water is excellent (distilled seawater). Power is 127V with US-style sockets; adapters are in the drawer under the TV. All windows have insect screens.
practical.houseRulesText: No smoking indoors; parties only by arrangement; the pool is unsupervised — look out for each other, especially with children.
practical.cancellationText: Free cancellation until 60 days before arrival. Between 60 and 35 days: the deposit remains due. Within 35 days: the full amount. We recommend travel insurance.

contact.title: Contact
contact.intro: Questions about the house or your booking? E-mail us — we usually reply within a day.
